verdict.rationale: Any public web service, including a government e-services portal like e-FRRO, could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no llms.txt or agent-facing documentation. The probes instead show the root serves a script-only application shell that leaves an agent 12 characters of text, and the long-published entry path returns 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
